kernel_contribution.kernel_differs_from_.reason: The adaptation combines a periodic screened-product local kernel with an explicit global one- and two-body Fourier ANOVA covariance. kernel_contribution.adaptation_motivated.reason: Periodicity addresses artificial angular seams; anisotropic local support addresses different torsional scales; global Fourier interaction terms encode coupled molecular torsions without making the stored local covariance dense. These choices are directly tied to the domain and its computational constraints.

kernel_contribution.domain_warrants_new_.reason: Six periodic molecular torsions, coupled relaxation, sharp energy changes, and support-volume loss create substantive geometric and covariance challenges. Executed stock-kernel and periodic-only comparisons show that the kernel choice materially affects performance under the sparse budget.

insight_contribution.insight_present.reason: The paper develops nontrivial insights beyond baseline improvement: global structure accounts for most of the gain, fitted interaction amplitudes favor cross-residue same-type couplings, and nearly constant predictive uncertainty produces different calibration failures across energy strata.

insight_contribution.insight_grounded_in.reason: The ablation, coupling-amplitude, support-width, and regional-calibration observations have concrete artifacts. These interpretations exceed the evidence.
